head: The Flames played last night
paras: The Avalanche won the first meeting this season, 7-3 in Calgary. The Flames come in at 5-7-0, the Avs at 7-5-1.
At home, Jared Bednar likes to pick matchups, so watch who goes out against the Flames’ second line. The Flames played last night; the Avalanche are rested.

items.text: The Flames are newly without Devin Cooley, and have been without Samuel Honzek, Maxim Tsyplakov, Joel Hanley and Connor Zary for several games. Dustin Wolf is expected to start.
Nathan MacKinnon has a point in five straight games against Calgary, with a goal in each of the last four, and 20 points in his last ten against them.
Artturi Lehkonen has a point in eight straight games.
Mikael Backlund is one point from passing Johnny Gaudreau for fifth on the Flames’ all-time scoring list.

COL.head: A big edge for the Avalanche
COL.body: Colorado has been out-chancing opponents by a wide margin lately and has home-ice advantage. It’s on the Flames to make it a game, and they can if they keep dangerous shots away.

CGY.head: The Avalanche should be favored
CGY.body: Colorado has been out-chancing opponents by a wide margin lately and has home-ice advantage. To pull this off, the Flames can start with keeping dangerous shots away, plus Dustin Wolf stealing the show.

calls.head: Gridin gets company tonight
calls.body: At home, the Avalanche keep sending Nelson’s line (Landeskog, Nelson and Roy) out against opponents’ second lines, far more often than chance would suggest. Jared Bednar has been using this group as a checking line on opponents’ second lines. Tonight the Flames’ second line is Gridin, Pospíšil and Strome.

calls.head: The Flames played last night
calls.body: The Flames played last night and get no rest before this one. Teams in that spot usually get the worse of the chances, so we expect the Avalanche to control more of the play than they usually do.

calls.head: Blackwood’s hold on the Flames won’t last
calls.body: Since 2023-24, Blackwood has been a wall against the Flames, well above his usual. Fans love a pattern like this, but we checked three seasons of them and they predicted nothing. Don’t be surprised if the Flames finally get to him.

calls.head: Expect the Avalanche to fire from everywhere
calls.body: Few teams shoot like the Avalanche, and the Flames are one of the league’s worst at keeping shots away. It could be a long night in the Flames’ end.
